entries.name: AAOIFI Shari'ah Standards and Financial Accounting Standards (FAS)
entries.publisher: Accounting and Auditing Organization for Islamic Financial Institutions (AAOIFI)
entries.version: Rolling: FAS 53 approved Feb 2026 (PR/01/2026); FAS 54 approved in principle Jun 2026
entries.versionBasis: AAOIFI Latest News page (aaoifi.com/latest-news-2/?lang=en), read live, lists PR/01/2026 (FAS 53 'Istisna-Based Development Contracts', 45th AAB meeting) and PR/02/2026 (FAS 54 in principle, 11 June 2026). There is no single edition number.

licence.text: Copyright AAOIFI; standards free to read online (e-standards) but no reuse licence
licence.basis: Read live on aaoifi.com: the site footer 'Copyright AAOIFI 2025 / Copyrights AAOIFI', and the announcement that all standards are available online free of charge, while AAOIFI does not approve other versions. No licence granting reuse rights was found.

norn.overlap: Islamic finance contracts (murabaha, ijarah, salam, istisna, sukuk, takaful), zakah reporting

priority.reason: Islamic finance contract terms (murabaha, ijara, sukuk) and their accounting.

entries.notes: The standards are free to read but copyright-protected. Printed editions are sold. The Shari'ah Standards count was not confirmed on the site.

entries.name: IFRS Accounting Taxonomy 2025
entries.versionBasis: Foundation release page states publication on 27 March 2025; its February 2026 notice explicitly retains 2025 for 2026 reporting.

licence.text: IFRS Taxonomy Materials Terms and Conditions; commercial permission required
licence.basis: Taxonomy terms clauses 2-3 allow limited personal/professional uses; commercial software, data services and commercial classification derivatives require Foundation permission. No such permission established for Norn.

norn.overlap: Financial reporting concepts can be mapped to accounts; this is neither a universal chart of accounts nor Egyptian Accounting Standards.

priority.reason: IFRS reporting concepts; commercial use needs permission.

entries.notes: No 2026 annual taxonomy was inferred from the clock. The 2025 package removes the IFRS for SMEs entry point; the Foundation directs SME users to 2024. Do not claim full Egyptian/EAS coverage. Redistribution: prohibited-without-permission.

entries.name: REA / ISO/IEC 15944-4 accounting and economic ontology availability
entries.versionBasis: ISO product page identifies edition 2, publication month 2015-04, and confirmation in 2021; lifecycle also lists published stage 26 March 2015. Preserve month-level publication field.

licence.text: ISO copyright; written reproduction permission required
licence.basis: ISO page explicitly reserves copyright and requires written permission for reproduction. No machine-readable export or redistribution permission established.

norn.overlap: REA is a conceptual design check, not permission to import prose or replace ruled ledger semantics.

priority.reason: The ISO text is paywalled; the REA concepts are already Norn's core physics.

entries.notes: The standard describes Open-edi Business Transaction Ontology and collaborations; do not claim a downloadable official REA OWL corpus. PDF-only material is never a source payload. Redistribution: prohibited-without-permission.

entries.name: 2026 US GAAP Financial Reporting Taxonomy
entries.versionBasis: Fetched ZIP META-INF/taxonomyPackage.xml declares version 2026 and publicationDate 2026-01-31; this is package metadata, not an asserted announcement date.

licence.text: FAF Taxonomies Terms and Conditions / Notice: Authorized Uses
licence.basis: Notice permits royalty-free GAAP reporting and unchanged incorporation in works explaining/implementing the taxonomy, with Authorized Uses notice on the first page. Modification needs consent except translation; imported third-party material retains separate terms.

norn.overlap: US disclosure taxonomy remains jurisdictional reporting evidence, not Core or an SME ledger design.

priority.reason: Ledger depth is the core of SAP parity.

entries.notes: The mutable terms page observed copyright ranges through 2027. That is recorded as a rights-page observation, not a 2027 release or a changed package date. Novel ontology derivatives are not automatically permitted works. Redistribution: license-conditions.

entries.name: Extensible Business Reporting Language (XBRL) 2.1
entries.versionBasis: specifications.xbrl.org XBRL 2.1 page, read live, lists 'XBRL Specification 2013-02-20' (Recommendation) with Conformance Suite 2025-07-16.

licence.text: Copyright XBRL International, all rights reserved, with a notice allowing the document to be copied and furnished to others, and derivative works that explain it or help implement it, if the notice is kept; the document itself may not be modified
licence.basis: Read the copyright and permission notice in the live spec HTML (xbrl.org/Specification/XBRL-2.1/REC-2003-12-31/...+corrected-errata-2013-02-20.html) today. It refers to the XBRL IP Policy at xbrl.org/legal, which was not opened.

priority.reason: Calculation linkbases are executable summation laws.

entries.notes: Verbatim redistribution only: the base XSDs can be vendored unmodified with the notice, but not edited. Taxonomies (IFRS, US GAAP, ESEF) carry their own licences. Reuse: copying is permitted unmodified with the notice; adaptation is not, so vocabulary-only.

entries.name: XBRL Global Ledger Taxonomy Framework 2015
entries.versionBasis: Recommendation date on the framework and specification index; ZIP returned application/zip.

licence.text: XBRL GL taxonomy custom copyright licence
licence.basis: Framework grants copying and implementation/explanatory derivatives with copyright notice and original URL; the taxonomy itself must remain unmodified except translations. Trademark and patent terms remain separate.

norn.overlap: Journal entries, accounts, parties and resources are external representations, not ledger semantics to promote.

priority.reason: Ledger depth is the core of SAP parity.

entries.notes: The observed recommendation is pinned as 2015, not labelled an invented 2026 release. Preserve dependency closure and source constraints before any lowering. Redistribution: license-conditions.
